title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Strikes 028 — Axial Thrust Recovery Reset Repair

source.name: Eric Lecarde

OBSERVED: whole sheet contains grounded polearm strike states with materially different directional envelopes

principle.name: ROOT BUYS THE LINE; TOOL OUTRUNS IT; RECOVERY PAYS PROXIMAL BEFORE DISTAL
principle.summary: The strike is earned by support and root before the shaft accelerates. Contact is a pin, not an endpoint. Body overrun creates recovery debt; pelvis brakes before the weapon finishes snapping back; the final stance remains displaced.
principle.repair_of: Pre-reset 001 read as a compact symmetric tween with endpoint contact and near-reset recovery. This successor separates support purchase, root release, shaft release, precontact, contact pin, body overrun, proximal brake, distal lag/snapback, overshoot, and displaced settle.

keys.name: READY_SCAR
keys.causal_role: readable baseline already carrying slight forward/tool debt; deliberately not symmetric
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis is aft of chest, rear foot is farther behind than front foot is ahead; shaft is shallow and does not bisect the body

keys.name: HEEL_BITE
keys.causal_role: anticipation begins in support and pelvis before the weapon is allowed to commit
keys.motion_arc_root_note: rear heel stays; pelvis drops and retreats; front knee softens; shaft retracts enough to reopen front negative space

keys.name: COIL_TWIST
keys.causal_role: asymmetric coil stores axial launch and torso counter-rotation
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis retreats again while chest rotates less; rear hand takes the butt; front heel is unweighted rather than teleported

keys.name: TOE_FLOAT_BRIDGE
keys.causal_role: authored support bridge buys launch clearance instead of sliding both feet
keys.motion_arc_root_note: front foot lifts one row and tucks; rear support remains planted; root is lowest and farthest back while shaft stays withheld

keys.name: FRONT_CATCH
keys.causal_role: front support catches farther forward before upper-body release; the step earns the coming thrust
keys.motion_arc_root_note: front foot plants at a new x while pelvis begins to rise/advance; shaft still compressed

keys.name: ROOT_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: root starts the strike; tool remains measurably late
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis and chest advance before the tip; rear leg lengthens while both hands remain near torso

keys.name: SHAFT_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: hands and shaft finally overtake the root; directional commitment becomes undeniable
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis advances modestly; chest opens; front hand shoots forward; tool tip outruns root by a large margin

keys.name: PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: last free-flight frame separates fast travel from the authored contact instant
keys.motion_arc_root_note: tool approaches the plane but has not touched it; front knee closes and chest forms a wedge behind the hands

keys.name: CONTACT_PIN
keys.causal_role: authored contact instant plus hit-stop implication; tip pins while body compresses behind it
keys.motion_arc_root_note: tip reaches abstract impact plane; pelvis advances one cell while chest compresses; contact is not the farthest body reach

keys.name: BODY_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: contact releases into consequence: body overruns the weapon line while rear support begins to leave
keys.motion_arc_root_note: tip barely advances and dips while pelvis/chest continue; rear heel peels toward catch; shaft angle changes under consequence

keys.name: PROXIMAL_BRAKE
keys.causal_role: pelvis brakes first; chest and hand pair are still paying forward momentum
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis almost stops; chest advances; rear foot is visibly in transit rather than snapping home; shaft begins shortening

keys.name: DISTAL_SNAPBACK
keys.causal_role: distal tool recoil happens after proximal brake; hands fold before the root is allowed to retreat
keys.motion_arc_root_note: rear foot catches forward of its original plant; pelvis barely moves; tool tip retracts hard and rear hand lags

keys.name: COUNTERSWING_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: recovery overshoots past compactness; shaft butt and rear hand lag while torso counter-rotates
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis retreats slightly but chest rotates back farther; tool becomes more compact than final stance, creating visible overshoot

keys.name: SETTLE_DEBT
keys.causal_role: settle without reset; readiness returns with displaced feet/root and a changed tool corridor
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new stance remains forward and narrower at rear; pelvis is nine cells ahead of opening ready; tool axis stays lower and shorter
